observations: 本期严格采用 2026-11-03 至 2026-11-09 的在线发表窗口，完整收录 7 篇原创研究，精选 5 篇。核心主题横跨多目标蛋白工程、脂滴界面三酶级联、非重氮卡宾前体的酶促环丙烷化、双核铜酶自由基（拟）卤化，以及祖先序列重建获得稳健过氧化酶。
设计对象正在从序列扩展到系统
本期的工程对象不再局限于单个位点：EvoMOBO 同时处理多项性能与有限实验预算；DeltaCata 直接学习突变引起的动力学参数变化；脂滴工作则把酶的朝向、界面分区与三级联通量纳入设计。三者共同提示，下一阶段的酶工程需要同时表达序列、几何、动力学与空间组织约束。
EvoMOBO 的实验结果限于一例旧黄酶氧化脱氢和一例甲酸氧化酶光酶级联；DeltaCata 的实验验证限于甲基转移酶 sGmOMT2；脂滴级联的 1300% 提升与 46.25 mg/L 产量针对原脱氧紫罗兰素体系；双核铜酶和血红素蛋白的新反应结论限于论文测试的酶变体、底物与条件；祖先 CYP152 的稳健性来自三种重建变体及其已测耐受范围，不能外推到整个家族。

items.title: Evolution-Inspired Multi-Objective Bayesian Optimization for Protein Engineering
items.cn: 进化启发的蛋白质工程多目标贝叶斯优化
items.topic: AI 与机器学习辅助酶研究
topics: AI 与机器学习辅助酶研究
items.summary: 研究者开发 EvoMOBO 主动学习框架，把路径依赖的序列生成、全局候选竞争和显式多目标优化结合起来。在两个完整蛋白景观上验证后，框架使用机理描述符指导两项酶工程：旧黄酶的非天然氧化脱氢底物转化率由 17.5% 提高至 95%；甲酸氧化酶的稳定性描述符筛得抗聚集变体，使光酶级联中的邻苯二甲酸二乙酯降解接近翻倍。
items.why: 它把多目标优化从单纯拟合历史实验数据推进到“机理描述符提出候选、实验只做最终验证”的工作流，适合评估有限实验预算下如何兼顾活性、稳定性与序列多样性。
items.evidence: Angew/Crossref 摘要支持：EvoMOBO 在 DBD 与 ParD3 完整景观的二目标和三目标任务中提高目标区域富集并保持多样性；几何或机理描述符用于两个酶工程任务；旧黄酶转化率从 17.5% 升至 95%，甲酸氧化酶变体使目标降解表现接近翻倍。
items.audience: 机器学习辅助酶工程、多目标优化、主动学习、稳定性设计与光酶级联研究者
items.verification: Angew 与 Crossref 确认 2026-11-08 在线发表；DOI、题名、作者、日期与摘要已核验，Crossref 未列更正或撤稿关系。

en.summary: The authors develop EvoMOBO, an active-learning framework that combines path-dependent sequence generation, global candidate competition and explicit multi-objective optimization. After validation on two complete protein landscapes, mechanistic descriptors guide two enzyme-engineering tasks: conversion in a non-native oxidative dehydrogenation by an old yellow enzyme rises from 17.5% to 95%, while stability descriptors identify aggregation-resistant formate oxidase variants that nearly double diethyl phthalate degradation in a photoenzymatic cascade.
en.why: The study moves multi-objective optimization beyond fitting historical experimental labels toward a workflow in which mechanistic descriptors nominate variants and experiments are reserved for final validation. It is especially relevant to campaigns that must balance activity, stability and sequence diversity under a limited testing budget.
en.evidence: The Angew/Crossref abstract supports improved target-region enrichment with retained diversity on two- and three-objective DBD and ParD3 landscape tasks, descriptor-guided optimization in two enzyme systems, an increase in old-yellow-enzyme conversion from 17.5% to 95%, and nearly doubled target degradation with formate oxidase variants.
en.audience: Researchers in machine-learning-assisted enzyme engineering, multi-objective optimization, active learning, stability design and photoenzymatic cascades
en.verification: Angew and Crossref confirm online publication on 8 November 2026. The DOI, title, authors, date and abstract were checked, and Crossref lists no correction or retraction relation.

items.title: Spatial control of enzyme orientation at the lipid droplet interface enables regio- and chemoselective metabolic flux
items.cn: 脂滴界面酶朝向的空间控制实现区域与化学选择性代谢通量
topics: 酶固定化与酶—材料体系
items.summary: 研究者把酵母脂滴的两亲界面改造成可编程支架，并以分子动力学设计锚定基序，使酶分别朝向胞质侧或脂滴内侧。将原脱氧紫罗兰素合成的三酶级联跨胞质—脂滴界面重新组织后，亲水底物向疏水产物的定向转化得到增强，产量提高 1300%，达到 46.25 mg/L。
items.why: 这项工作把“是否定位到细胞器”推进到“以什么朝向定位在界面上”。它为多酶级联提供了可调的空间变量，适合研究中间体通道、疏水产物分配和细胞内界面催化。
items.evidence: Science Advances/Crossref 摘要支持：分子动力学指导脂滴锚定基序设计，获得胞质侧或脂滴内侧朝向；三酶 PDV 级联跨界面重排；PDV 产量提高 1300% 至 46.25 mg/L。
items.audience: 多酶级联、合成细胞器、空间代谢工程、界面酶学与天然产物生物合成研究者
items.verification: Science Advances 与 Crossref 确认 2026-11-06 发表并提供摘要；DOI、作者和日期已核验，Crossref 未列更正或撤稿关系；OpenAlex 标记为 article、非附属文本且未撤稿。

en.summary: The authors reprogram the amphiphilic interface of yeast lipid droplets as a programmable scaffold. Molecular-dynamics-guided anchoring motifs orient enzymes toward either the cytosol or the lipid-droplet interior. Reorganizing a three-enzyme prodeoxyviolacein cascade across this interface promotes directional conversion of hydrophilic substrates into a hydrophobic product, increasing production by 1,300% to 46.25 mg/L.
en.why: The study advances organelle targeting from a question of location to one of interfacial orientation. It introduces a tunable spatial variable for studying intermediate transfer, hydrophobic product partitioning and intracellular interfacial catalysis in multi-enzyme cascades.
en.evidence: The Science Advances/Crossref abstract supports molecular-dynamics-guided design of lipid-droplet anchors, cytosol-facing and inward-facing enzyme configurations, reorganization of a three-enzyme PDV cascade across the interface, and a 1,300% increase in PDV production to 46.25 mg/L.
en.audience: Researchers in multi-enzyme cascades, synthetic organelles, spatial metabolic engineering, interfacial enzymology and natural-product biosynthesis
en.verification: Science Advances and Crossref confirm publication on 6 November 2026 and provide the abstract. The DOI, authors and date were checked; Crossref lists no correction or retraction relation, and OpenAlex classifies the work as a non-paratext article that is not retracted.

items.title: Highly Stereoselective Olefin Cyclopropanation via Enzyme-Catalyzed Reductive Activation of gem-Dibromoalkanes
items.cn: 酶催化还原活化偕二溴烷实现高立体选择性烯烃环丙烷化
items.journal: Journal of the American Chemical Society
items.topic: 酶动力学、选择性与底物特异性
topics: 酶动力学、选择性与底物特异性
items.summary: 工程化血红素蛋白以偕二溴烷而非重氮化合物作为卡宾前体，催化烯烃不对称环丙烷化。该方法适用于带给电子或吸电子取代基的乙烯基芳烃，可获得反式 1,2-二芳基环丙烷，最高产率超过 99%，非对映选择性超过 99:1，ee 最高超过 99%；还扩展到螺环骨架和 σ 键卡宾插入。
items.why: 非天然卡宾转移长期依赖重氮前体。这项工作通过还原活化偕二溴烷拓展前体类型，并把自由基生成与血红素卡宾中间体衔接起来，为开发更广的酶促卡宾化学提供了可检验路径。
items.evidence: JACS/Crossref 摘要支持：偕二溴烷用于酶促环丙烷化；乙烯基芳烃产物最高超过 99% 产率、超过 99:1 d.r.、最高超过 99% ee；方法扩展至螺环与 σ 键插入；机理研究支持 α-卤自由基参与生成反应性血红素卡宾物种。
items.audience: 血红素酶、非天然催化、卡宾转移、自由基生物催化与手性环丙烷合成研究者
items.verification: JACS/ACS 与 Crossref 确认 2026-11-06 在线发表并提供一致摘要；DOI、作者与日期已核验，Crossref 未列更正或撤稿关系；OpenAlex 标记为 article、非附属文本且未撤稿。

en.summary: Engineered haemoproteins use gem-dibromoalkanes, rather than diazo compounds, as carbene precursors for asymmetric olefin cyclopropanation. The method accepts vinylarenes with electron-donating or electron-withdrawing substituents and furnishes trans-1,2-diarylcyclopropanes in up to >99% yield, >99:1 d.r. and up to >99% ee; it is also extended to spirocyclic scaffolds and sigma-bond carbene insertion.
en.why: New-to-nature carbene transfer has relied heavily on diazo precursors. Reductive activation of gem-dibromoalkanes broadens the precursor class and connects radical generation to a haem-carbenoid intermediate, offering a testable route toward a wider enzyme-catalysed carbene chemistry.
en.evidence: The JACS/Crossref abstract supports enzyme-catalysed cyclopropanation with gem-dibromoalkanes, vinylarene products in up to >99% yield, >99:1 d.r. and up to >99% ee, extension to spirocycles and sigma-bond insertion, and mechanistic evidence for an alpha-halo radical en route to the reactive haem-carbenoid species.
en.audience: Researchers in haem enzymes, new-to-nature catalysis, carbene transfer, radical biocatalysis and chiral cyclopropane synthesis
en.verification: JACS/ACS and Crossref confirm online publication on 6 November 2026 and provide consistent abstracts. The DOI, authors and date were checked; Crossref lists no correction or retraction relation, and OpenAlex classifies the work as a non-paratext article that is not retracted.

items.title: A binuclear copper enzyme platform for enantioconvergent radical (pseudo)halogenation
items.cn: 双核铜酶平台实现对映汇聚自由基（拟）卤化
topics: 酶动力学、选择性与底物特异性
items.summary: 研究者系统筛选并改造天然铜酶用于非天然自由基（拟）卤化。III 型双核铜酶中，巨大芽孢杆菌酪氨酸酶经工程化后可对稳定和非稳定烷基自由基进行高对映选择性叠氮化；双核铜体系较强的卤离子结合还支持对映汇聚溴化、氯化与异硫氰酸化。
items.why: 非天然金属酶催化多集中于单核血红素或非血红素铁中心。这项工作把耦合双核铜位点建立为可工程化自由基平台，并用光谱证据连接铜物种、配体结合与活性提升。
items.evidence: Nature Chemistry 摘要支持：多个铜酶家族具有红氧活性酯脱羧叠氮化活性；工程化 BmTyr 对稳定和非稳定烷基自由基表现更高活性与对映选择性；双核铜位点支持溴化、氯化和异硫氰酸化；EPR 与紫外—可见光谱确认耦合双核特征并分析活性来源。
items.audience: 金属酶工程、铜酶、自由基生物催化、光金属生物催化与不对称卤化研究者
items.verification: Nature Chemistry 出版商页面确认类别为 Article、2026-11-05 发表并提供摘要；Crossref DOI、题名、作者和日期已核验且未列更正或撤稿关系；OpenAlex 标记为 article、非附属文本且未撤稿。

en.summary: The authors systematically screen and reprogramme natural copper enzymes for non-natural radical (pseudo)halogenation. Among type III binuclear copper enzymes, engineered Bacillus megaterium tyrosinase supports highly enantioselective azidation of both stabilized and unstabilized alkyl radicals. Strong halide binding by the binuclear copper system also enables enantioconvergent bromination, chlorination and isothiocyanation.
en.why: New-to-nature metalloenzyme catalysis has centred largely on mononuclear haem and non-haem iron sites. This work establishes a coupled binuclear copper centre as an engineerable radical-reaction platform and uses spectroscopy to connect copper speciation and ligand binding with improved activity.
en.evidence: The Nature Chemistry abstract supports decarboxylative azidation activity across several copper-enzyme families, improved activity and enantioselectivity of engineered BmTyr toward stabilized and unstabilized alkyl radicals, extension to bromination, chlorination and isothiocyanation, and EPR/UV-visible evidence for the coupled binuclear copper state and its functional interpretation.
en.audience: Researchers in metalloenzyme engineering, copper enzymes, radical biocatalysis, photometallobiocatalysis and asymmetric halogenation
en.verification: The Nature Chemistry publisher page identifies the work as an Article, gives a publication date of 5 November 2026 and provides the abstract. The Crossref DOI, title, authors and date were checked with no correction or retraction relation listed; OpenAlex classifies the work as a non-paratext article that is not retracted.

items.title: Resurrecting Robust CYP152 Peroxygenases for Versatile Biocatalysis
items.cn: 复活稳健 CYP152 过氧化酶用于多功能生物催化
items.summary: 研究者表征 8 个祖先序列重建的 CYP152 变体，观察到系统树位置与羟化/脱羧偏好变化相关。三种重建变体的 Tm 为 66–76°C，并耐受溶剂、过氧化氢和极端 pH，同时可处理非天然底物；CYP152-AncG2 还能用于一锅化学—酶促 C–C 偶联制备甲氧基二苯乙烯。
items.why: 祖先重建在这里不仅提高热稳定性，还同时扩展了过程耐受性和底物使用范围，并给出反应偏好转换的结构线索。这使重建变体既是进化机制探针，也是后续定向进化的起始模板。
items.evidence: Angew/Crossref 摘要支持：8 个重建变体被表征；羟化/脱羧偏好变化与 Q85H、FG 环插入等特征相关；三种变体 Tm 为 66–76°C 且耐受溶剂、H2O2 与极端 pH；AncG2 完成一锅 C–C 偶联；1.83 Å 结构和分子动力学用于解释稳健性。
items.audience: P450/过氧化酶、祖先序列重建、稳定性工程、结构酶学与化学—酶促级联研究者
items.verification: Angew 与 Crossref 确认 2026-11-04 在线发表并提供摘要；DOI、题名、作者和日期已核验，Crossref 未列更正或撤稿关系；OpenAlex 标记为 article、非附属文本且未撤稿。

en.summary: The authors characterize eight ancestral-sequence-reconstructed CYP152 variants and observe a phylogeny-associated shift between hydroxylation and decarboxylation preferences. Three reconstructed variants have melting temperatures of 66–76 degrees Celsius, tolerate solvents, hydrogen peroxide and extreme pH, and accept non-native substrates. CYP152-AncG2 also supports a one-pot chemoenzymatic C–C coupling to make methoxy stilbene.
en.why: Here ancestral reconstruction improves more than thermostability: it broadens process tolerance and substrate use while exposing structural features associated with changes in reaction preference. The reconstructed proteins therefore serve both as evolutionary probes and as starting templates for directed evolution.
en.evidence: The Angew/Crossref abstract supports characterization of eight reconstructed variants, association of the hydroxylation/decarboxylation transition with Q85H and an FG-loop insertion among other features, melting temperatures of 66–76 degrees Celsius for three variants with solvent, peroxide and extreme-pH tolerance, a one-pot C–C coupling by AncG2, and mechanistic interpretation using a 1.83-angstrom structure and molecular dynamics.
en.audience: Researchers in P450s and peroxygenases, ancestral sequence reconstruction, stability engineering, structural enzymology and chemoenzymatic cascades
en.verification: Angew and Crossref confirm online publication on 4 November 2026 and provide the abstract. The DOI, title, authors and date were checked; Crossref lists no correction or retraction relation, and OpenAlex classifies the work as a non-paratext article that is not retracted.

items.title: Effective enzyme engineering through modeling kinetic parameter changes upon mutations with geometric deep learning
items.cn: 以几何深度学习建模突变引起的动力学参数变化促进酶工程
items.topic: AI 与机器学习辅助酶研究
topics: AI 与机器学习辅助酶研究
酶动力学、选择性与底物特异性
items.summary: 研究者从相同实验条件下测得的野生型—突变体配对数据建立酶突变效应数据集，并开发孪生几何图神经网络 DeltaCata，直接预测 Δkcat 与 ΔKm，而不是先预测绝对参数。模型在未见酶上优于现有方法，并用于筛选甲基转移酶 sGmOMT2 的有益突变，使体外淫羊藿素合成的催化效率最高提高 7.0 倍。
items.why: 直接学习突变差值更接近酶工程实际决策。该工作同时把数据配对条件、结构几何和实验终点连接起来，是评估动力学预测模型能否真正支持突变筛选的重要案例。
items.evidence: Nature Communications 摘要支持：数据由相同条件下的野生型与突变体动力学参数配对构建；DeltaCata 直接预测 Δkcat 与 ΔKm；模型在未见酶上改善明显；深度突变扫描用于计算验证；sGmOMT2 实验获得最高 7.0 倍催化效率提升。
items.audience: 酶动力学、几何深度学习、突变效应预测、甲基转移酶与计算酶工程研究者
items.verification: Nature Communications 出版商页面确认类别为 Article、2026-11-05 发表并提供摘要；Crossref DOI、作者与日期已核验且未列更正或撤稿关系；OpenAlex 标记为 article、非附属文本且未撤稿。

en.summary: The authors build an enzyme mutation-effect dataset by pairing wild-type and mutant kinetic measurements collected under identical experimental conditions, then develop DeltaCata, a Siamese geometric graph neural network that predicts delta-kcat and delta-Km directly rather than first estimating absolute parameters. The model improves performance on unseen enzymes and guides beneficial-mutation screening for the methyltransferase sGmOMT2, yielding up to a 7.0-fold increase in catalytic efficiency for in vitro icaritin synthesis.
en.why: Learning mutational differences directly is closer to the decision made in an engineering campaign. By linking condition-matched data, structural geometry and an experimental endpoint, the study provides a useful test of whether kinetic prediction can support practical variant selection.
en.evidence: The Nature Communications abstract supports construction of condition-matched wild-type/mutant kinetic pairs, direct prediction of delta-kcat and delta-Km by DeltaCata, improved performance on enzymes unseen during training, computational screening with deep-mutational-scanning datasets, and an experimentally measured improvement of up to 7.0-fold for sGmOMT2.
en.audience: Researchers in enzyme kinetics, geometric deep learning, mutation-effect prediction, methyltransferases and computational enzyme engineering
en.verification: The Nature Communications publisher page identifies the work as an Article, gives a publication date of 5 November 2026 and provides the abstract. The Crossref DOI, authors and date were checked with no correction or retraction relation listed; OpenAlex classifies the work as a non-paratext article that is not retracted.

items.title: Allosteric network rewiring governs enzyme functional duality via a distal switch
items.cn: 远端开关通过变构网络重连调控酶的功能二元性
topics: 酶动力学、选择性与底物特异性
items.summary: 以 II 型 meso-DAPDH 为模型，研究者识别出远离活性位点的 M176 开关；该位点替换可解耦胺化与脱氨活性。不同底物下，突变伴随亚基内接触相关网络重组、底物解离自由能变化及不同催化结果；模拟与突变分析进一步检验了与功能解耦相关的特定位点。
items.why: 这项工作没有把远端突变简化为单条静态变构通路，而是比较底物依赖的网络重组与自由能景观，为设计反应方向或底物条件依赖的功能拆分提供了集合态视角。
items.evidence: Communications Biology 摘要支持：M176 替换解耦胺化与脱氨功能；变化与底物依赖的接触相关网络重组、解离自由能和活性结果相联系；模拟与突变用于验证相关残基，并区分反复出现的网络特征与推定的残基路径。
items.audience: 变构调控、DAPDH、远端突变、分子模拟与机制导向酶工程研究者
items.verification: Communications Biology 出版商页面确认类别为 Article、2026-11-07 发表并提供摘要；Crossref DOI、题名、作者和日期已核验且未列更正或撤稿关系。

en.summary: Using a type II meso-DAPDH as a model, the authors identify distal residue M176 as a switch whose substitutions can decouple amination and deamination activities. Under different substrates, these substitutions coincide with reorganization of intra-subunit contact-correlation networks, altered substrate-dissociation free-energy profiles and distinct catalytic outcomes; simulations and mutational analyses further test residues associated with functional decoupling.
en.why: Rather than reducing a distal mutation to one static allosteric pathway, the study compares substrate-dependent network reorganization and free-energy landscapes. This ensemble view is relevant to engineering reaction- or substrate-contingent separation of enzyme functions.
en.evidence: The Communications Biology abstract supports functional decoupling by M176 substitutions, association with substrate-dependent contact-correlation network reorganization, dissociation free energies and catalytic outcomes, and combined simulation/mutational tests that distinguish recurring network features from putative residue-level routes.
en.audience: Researchers in allostery, DAPDH enzymes, distal mutations, molecular simulation and mechanism-guided enzyme engineering
en.verification: The Communications Biology publisher page identifies the work as an Article, gives a publication date of 7 November 2026 and provides the abstract. The Crossref DOI, title, authors and date were checked, with no correction or retraction relation listed.

observationsEn: This edition uses the strict online-publication window of 3–9 November 2026, with seven original studies in the full intake and five editor's picks. The leading themes are multi-objective protein engineering, a lipid-droplet three-enzyme cascade, enzyme-catalysed cyclopropanation from a non-diazo carbene precursor, radical (pseudo)halogenation by binuclear copper enzymes, and robust peroxygenases obtained by ancestral sequence reconstruction.
The design object is expanding from sequence to system

This week's engineering targets extend beyond individual residues. EvoMOBO handles several properties under a limited testing budget; DeltaCata models mutation-induced changes in kinetic parameters directly; and the lipid-droplet study treats enzyme orientation, interfacial partitioning and cascade flux as design variables. Together they argue for representations that combine sequence, geometry, kinetics and spatial organization.

EvoMOBO's experimental results are limited to one old-yellow-enzyme oxidative dehydrogenation and one formate-oxidase photoenzymatic cascade; DeltaCata's experimental validation is limited to sGmOMT2; the 1,300% increase and 46.25 mg/L titre for the lipid-droplet cascade refer to the prodeoxyviolacein system; the new reactions of binuclear copper enzymes and haemoproteins apply to the tested variants, substrates and conditions; and CYP152 robustness is supported by three reconstructed variants within the reported tolerance tests, not the entire family.
